items.title: 6.3.1.2 Web Hosting and Content Delivery (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of web hosting and content delivery (PDF 159-160).

blocks.text: Cloud computing websites host karne aur duniya bhar mein content pohanchane ka infrastructure deti hai. AWS aur Microsoft Azure karobaron ki websites cloud servers par host karte hain, aur Cloudflare jaise content delivery networks (CDNs) content ko users ke qareeb servers par cache kar ke jaldi pohanchate hain.

blocks.prompt: CDN website ko tez kyun load karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh content ki copies har user ke qareeb servers par rakhta hai, to data kam faasla tay karta hai.

items: Cloud servers par web hosting; CDNs content users ke qareeb cache karte hain (Cloudflare).
